text: ＊は　まひして　わざが　でにくくなった！

structure.jp: わざが　でにくくなった！
structure.en: its moves became hard to get out!

patterns.name: 〜にくい
patterns.explanation: にくい stuck onto a verb says the action is hard to do. でにくい = 'hard to come out'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: Changing the last い to く and adding なる says something becomes that way. でにくくなった = 'became hard to come out'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins this action to the next one, like 'and'. まひして = 'got paralyzed, and'.
